checks.detail: The existing composition suite checks standalone patches, every shared-entry combination, the complete/default sets and each patch disabled from the complete set. Outputs are deterministic, unrelated entries stay exact, distinct JavaScript outputs parse, and independent/default archive, header and executable pins match.

checks.name: local-Ubuntu-26.04-WSL2-toolkit-and-native-runtime
checks.detail: Current CLI 0.169.0-alpha.11.1 reproduces stock project-path, unfiltered Remote Control listing, hosted Apps authentication and cache-location failures. Proxy/relay, enrollment/pairing reuse, listing/filtering/pagination/reconnect, connector discovery/errors and membership persistence pass in temporary state. Source and GraphQL checks ran separately.

checks.name: stock-WSL2-app-server
checks.scope: Bundled stock CLI with temporary home/database; no user credentials.

checks.name: hosted-Windows-and-Ubuntu-26.04-WSL2
checks.note: The follow-up commit records public evidence only; patch, runtime, test and CI code remains identical to this successful compatibility run. The optional Chromium case passed separately in the local source-derived rendering suite.

patchDecisions.app: All eight app patches remain needed. Exact-source revisions and fixtures follow the renamed bundles and native functions. Project memberships remain opt-in.
patchDecisions.pet: Stock still joins a Windows home with POSIX semantics. The helper is inserted into the current pet-loader module. Actual-source discovery, selection, installation, collision and traversal checks pass across Windows, POSIX and WSL UNC homes.
patchDecisions.browserService: The upstream generator is now async and verifies the service file. The Windows/WSL path fix covers both trusted-service registration and fs.stat, preserving the native missing-file gate. Tests cover 90 platform/path/backend combinations plus 12 file-verification cases with present and missing services.
patchDecisions.security: Browser transient recovery preserves native supported-client restrictions, workspace policy and first-party inference checks. Native Work/backend-auth validity, explicit denials, account-switch checks, API-key identities, latest disables, local-only audio and active-turn protection remain covered.
patchDecisions.runtimeRecovery: Current native reconciliation tracking and the waitForReconcile:false snapshot request remain intact. Source tests cover bounded sync retries, coalesced chat recovery, latest settings, focus retries and partial failures. The fixture executes the native reconciliation tracker.
patchDecisions.sidebar: Stock retains expansion when a project is closed and reopened. Tests restore five chats, allow Show more again, leave another project expanded, and retain the native repair callback.
patchDecisions.runtime: All four runtime patches remain needed with bundled CLI 0.169.0-alpha.11.1; native stock-versus-patched scenarios pass.
patchDecisions.fixtures: Native module factories are registered without executing the current application entry. Async source functions are awaited. Current native dependencies are injected explicitly; no live application or user state is started by the source fixtures.
patchDecisions.retired: The GraphQL shell guard and pet-home aliases remain retired. Stock query variables and apostrophe arguments survive the Windows Node/wsl.exe boundary without external requests.

proposal.note: The original candidate and original source failures are retained as historical evidence. The updated code passed the fresh signed-package, Windows and actual hosted Ubuntu WSL2 checks.

limitations: No generated app copy was activated; the app was not restarted and saved settings/data were not changed.
Current-build Application Control permission, startup, desktop theme, interactive pets, actual agent Browser/Computer Use, authenticated connector inventory and real-phone reconnect remain pending.
Existing Application Control and initial theme-mismatch observations remain recorded. Android project-label display remains a separate accepted limitation.
